q02.question: The sum_numbers function in sum.c contains a common error regarding arrays and pointers. Which of the following options explains this error and fixes it?

responses.d: To use sizeof on an array, you must deference it first; so do sizeof(&numbers).
responses.e: You shouldn't use sizeof to get the size of an array; pass the size of the array in as an additional argument.
responses.f: You shouldn't use sizeof to get the size of an array; use len(array) instead.
